DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL).

The peripheral smear findings of immature cells with Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) and significant thrombocytopenia are classic for APL, a medical emergency requiring immediate differentiation from other leukemias. I will proceed with immediate confirmation testing.
